name: @selendra/terminal-indexer
description: SubQuery indexer for Selendra Terminal - unified dual-VM blockchain explorer

scripts.start:docker: docker compose pull && docker compose up --remove-orphans
scripts.start:local: cd .. && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d postgres subquery-node graphql-engine
scripts.logs: cd .. && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs -f subquery-node graphql-engine
scripts.dev: subql build && docker compose pull && docker compose up --remove-orphans

author: Selendra Team
